BiblicalUsage: Zaza is one of the sons of Jonathan, a descendant of Jerahmeel in the tribe of Judah, named in the long genealogy of Chronicles. He appears once, in a list of names that most readers skip, and the Bible gives him no story beyond his place in the family.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe no name in God's book is filler, and Zaza is remembered because his family mattered to the tribe of Judah.
